mapper.select: SELECT alarm_id alarmId, `name`, grade, driver_id driverId, trip_id tripId, detail, result_process resultProcess, remark, b_id bId, community_id communityId FROM pubcar_alarm WHERE b_id = #{bId} and status_cd = #{statusCd}
mapper.insert: insert into business_pubcar_alarm (b_id, alarm_id, name, grade, driver_id, driver_name, trip_id, detail, result_process, remark, operate, community_id) values (#{bId}, #{alarmId}, #{name}, #{grade}, #{driverId}, #{driverName}, #{tripId}, #{detail}, #{resultProcess}, #{remark}, #{operate}, #{communityId});

insert into pubcar_alarm(alarm_id, name, grade, driver_id, driver_name, trip_id, detail, b_id, status_cd, community_id) select alarm_id, name, grade, driver_id, driver_name, trip_id, detail, b_id, '0', community_id from business_pubcar_alarm where b_id = #{bId} and operate = #{operate}
